name: Stenomyti
sum: Stenomyti is a small aetosaur from the Late Triassic Chinle Formation of Colorado, known from a skull and postcranial skeleton.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: A skull and postcranial skeleton from the Chinle Formation, Eagle Basin, Colorado; catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: The holotype and other referred material.
biology: The sources consulted describe its anatomy, noting osteoderms nearly identical to those of Aetosaurus, but give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Small and Martz 2013

sources.text: B. J. Small and J. W. Martz. 2013. A new aetosaur from the Upper Triassic Chinle Formation of the Eagle Basin, Colorado, USA. Anatomy, Phylogeny, and Palaeobiology of Early Archosaurs and their Kin. Geological Society, London, Special Publications 379:393-412
